Subject: Lumina Therapeutics — security QA kickoff: KMS & HIPAA scoping

Hi Daniel (and Lumina security team),

Thanks again for taking the time today — great call. Quick recap and the asks we promised to follow up on so your security team can evaluate Redwood for potential production use. I included Connor from our Security Operations team to help with the evidence and KMS questions.

Summary from our call:
- Primary use: document summarization + patient-facing content generation in a US-only deployment.
- Data residency: all PHI will remain in Lumina's VPC (private deployment) for regulated workflows.
- Compliance priorities you mentioned: HIPAA coverage for PHI, SOC 2 Type II evidence for SaaS controls, and clarification on key management options.

Immediate requests / next steps:
1) SIG/CAIQ preference: you said you prefer a SIG-lite + supporting artifacts. We can run the SIG prefill for you and mark questions that require legal input. Please confirm SIG-lite vs full CAIQ.
2) SOC 2: We can share our SOC 2 Type II summary (control maps + executive summary). Please confirm whether you need the full report via NDA and the name/email of the person who should receive it.
3) KMS & key residency: We support customer-managed KMS for Private deployments (Bring-Your-Own-Key). Do you require HSM-backed keys or managed KMS is sufficient? Also confirm whether keys must be provisioned in your AWS account or you prefer Redwood to manage a tenant-specific key.
4) Evidence & timeline: if you can provide a list of high-priority questions (e.g., encryption at rest, dataflow diagrams), we will assemble an evidence bundle. Typical turnaround for a SIG prefill + evidence bundle is 3–5 business days once we have the priority list and SOC 2 distribution contact.

Attachments I will share in the next message: a short activation checklist and our SOC 2 summary.

Proposed immediate milestone: we run the SIG prefill and return a highlighted worksheet showing items that need legal/ops input within 72 hours from confirmation.

If that all sounds right, reply to this thread with: (A) SIG format chosen (SIG-lite / CAIQ / custom) and (B) SOC 2 report recipient email. We'll take it from there.

Best,

Olga Petrov

olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0142

Hi Olga,

Thanks for the clear recap. A few clarifying items from our security team so you can prepare the right artifacts:

1) SIG vs CAIQ: we typically accept a SIG-lite prefill plus SOC 2 evidence. That will speed review — so SIG-lite is preferred unless you recommend otherwise.
2) SOC 2: please send the SOC 2 Type II executive summary to security@luminatherapeutics.com. For the full report we will run it through procurement and legal; that contact is maria.lopez@luminatherapeutics.com.
3) KMS: for our regulated workloads we require customer-managed KMS with HSM-backed keys and keys stored in our AWS account (us-east-1). Please confirm whether Redwood can support that for Private deployments.
4) Dataflow: please include a short diagram (PDF) showing how data flows between Lumina's VPC and any Redwood control plane endpoints — we only need the high-level flow and where PHI is touched.

Timeline: if you can return the SIG-lite prefill + SOC2 summary + a short note on KMS feasibility by EOD Thursday, that would be ideal.

Thanks — Daniel

Hi Daniel — Connor here. Quick notes on KMS provisioning path and what I need from you:

1) Preferred: customer-managed key in your AWS account (us-east-1) using AWS KMS with HSM-protected keys. If you confirm, I'll send a CloudFormation snippet + IAM role that will allow us to reference your key for encryption operations within the Private deployment.
2) Alternatives: we can manage tenant-specific keys in an HSM (FIPS 140-2) on our side, but some customers prefer the key ownership in their account for compliance.
3) Required from Lumina for provisioning: AWS account id, an admin contact for key rotation notices, and a short Terraform/CloudFormation deploy role we can assume (we provide the template). If you prefer, we can do a one-time walkthrough.

I'll prepare the runbook and the CFN/TF snippet and attach it to the SIG prefill draft. Expect that by EOD Thursday. If you want the template earlier for internal review, tell me and I'll send it later today.
